scripts.dev: concurrently -n "main,renderer,electron" -c "blue,green,yellow" "pnpm run dev:main" "pnpm run dev:renderer" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && pnpm run start:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.pack:dev: pnpm run version:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.pack:test: pnpm run version:test && cross-env NODE_ENV=test electron-builder --config electron-builder.test.yml
scripts.pack:prod: pnpm run version:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --config electron-builder.prod.yml
scripts.pack:mac:dev: pnpm run version:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.pack:win:dev: pnpm run version:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.pack:linux:dev: pnpm run version:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.pack:mac:prod: pnpm run version:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.prod.yml
scripts.pack:win:prod: pnpm run version:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.prod.yml
scripts.pack:linux:prod: pnpm run version:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.prod.yml
scripts.pack:all:dev: pnpm run version:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron-builder --mac --win --linux --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.pack:all:test: pnpm run version:test && cross-env NODE_ENV=test electron-builder --mac --win --linux --config electron-builder.test.yml
scripts.pack:all:prod: pnpm run version:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --mac --win --linux --config electron-builder.prod.yml
scripts.dist:dev: pnpm run version:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm run build:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.dist:test: pnpm run version:test && cross-env NODE_ENV=test pnpm run build:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=test electron-builder --config electron-builder.test.yml
scripts.dist:prod: pnpm run version:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpm run build:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder --config electron-builder.prod.yml
scripts.reinstall:electron: pnpm remove electron && pnpm add -D electron && pnpm run install:electron
scripts.fix:electron: rm -rf node_modules/.pnpm/electron* node_modules/electron && pnpm install && pnpm run install:electron
